steps.name: Collect the exports
steps.does: Downloads administrator positions export and trading system positions export (CSV) from portals and saves them. Counts rows and compares row count and control total with the file footer.
steps.control: Row count and file totals match the file (batch_control_totals).
steps.exception: A rejected file is re-requested the same day.

steps.name: Check cash against the administrator
steps.does: Opens cash tab of reconciliation workbook and pastes administrator cash balances beside trading export balances, one row per entity per day. A formula column shows the difference.
steps.control: Difference per entity per day inside cash_tolerance (5,000 USD).
steps.exception: Over tolerance opens a break case; Raj is told by email.

steps.name: Collect manager statements
steps.does: Saves PDF to manager folder, types fund, period end, value and received date into statements tracker (Excel), and checks against expected list. Writes follow-up email for anything late or missing. Quarterly funds are carried forward in months with no statement.
steps.control: Every expected statement received by statement_due (10 business days).
steps.exception: Late or missing: follow-up draft to the manager.

steps.name: Convert to SGD
steps.does: Takes holdings values from tracker and cash from recon workbook and converts to SGD in a separate Excel file, looking up the WMR 4pm USD/SGD fixing for the period end. The conversion is typed in.
steps.control: WMR 4pm fixing of the period end (fx_fixing).

steps.name: Review and approve the report
steps.does: Assembles the report pack from the converted figures and sends it for review.
steps.control: Maker never checker; estimates only in the investment report (estimate_use).
steps.exception: A revision over cio_materiality (100,000 USD or 0.5% of a fund) reopens the review.

steps.name: Read the report
steps.exception: Questions to managers logged as open questions.
